script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are flashing red because Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is about to ignite a volatile square that changes everything. Transiting Mars forms a furious square to Pluto in Aquarius, flooding your 8th House with pressure. Meanwhile, the Sun opposes your natal Mars in the 2nd House of Income, creating a power struggle over money. If single, a Scorpio or Capricorn will challenge your ego in a way that sparks attraction. If taken, avoid controlling arguments tonight—your partner's silence is not agreement, it's a boundary. Your 10th House of Career is lit by a trine from Jupiter in Gemini, meaning a promotion arrives through networking. But check contracts—stalled communication in your 6th House could hide fine print. Avoid lending money to family today—the 8th House square demands you protect your resources, not rescue them. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss the lunar eclipse shifting your foundation.
